topic: Calling a Cooking Hotline for a Substitute

script.title: CALLING THE COOKING HOTLINE
script.scene_zh: 廚房 · 打給烹飪熱線
script.story_hook: A home cook calls a hotline mid-recipe panic.
script.intro_zh: 做菜做到一半少了材料，趕緊打給烹飪熱線。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today someone calls a cooking hotline.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天有人打給了烹飪熱線。
script.outro: That's the swap, done! Listen again and repeat every line.
script.outro_zh: 換材料就搞定！再聽一次，跟著唸每句。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the useful lines together, slowly.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起慢慢跟讀這些實用的句子。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍳📞廚房求助英文｜問替代材料・聽清楚比例・救回晚餐｜聽完就會煮｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
食譜要一杯酪漿，家裡卻用光了？
用英文打烹飪熱線，該怎麼問？
比例、火候這些詞要聽懂哪幾個？

這一集帶大家走進一間熱鬧的廚房，跟著爸爸從說明卡關、問替代材料、聽清楚比例，一路把晚餐救回來，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
🥣 說明問題：例如「I'm stuck mid-recipe and need a swap.」、「I'm out of buttermilk.」。
🍋 問替代與比例：例如「Add one tablespoon of lemon juice.」、「Just one cup of milk in total.」。
🔥 聽小技巧：例如「Keep the heat medium」、「Don't overmix it, seriously.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把廚房裡的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次煮飯卡住，別慌，一通電話就能把晚餐救回來！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a whisk over a mixing bowl

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm stuck mid-recipe and need a swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm stʌk mɪd ˈrɛsəpi ənd nid ə swæp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我做菜做到一半卡住了，想找替換材料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, happy to help. What are you making?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ˈhæpi tə hɛlp wʌt ɑr ju ˈmeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，很樂意幫忙。你在做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buttermilk pancakes, but I'm out of buttermilk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtərˌmɪlk ˈpænˌkeɪks bʌt aɪm aʊt ʌv ˈbʌtərˌmɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 酪漿鬆餅，但酪漿用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy fix. Do you have regular milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi fɪks du ju hæv ˈrɛɡjʊrəl mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 很好解決。你有普通牛奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one percent. Will that work here?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn pərˈsɛnt wɪl ðæt wɜrk hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Add one tablespoon of lemon juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt æd wʌn ˈteɪblˌspʌn ʌv ˈlɛmən dʒus/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。加一湯匙檸檬汁進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much milk for one cup of buttermilk, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɪlk fɔr wʌn kʌp ʌv ˈbʌtərˌmɪlk ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那一杯酪漿要換多少牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one cup of milk in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn kʌp ʌv mɪlk ɪn ˈtoʊtəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and I wait before using it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ənd aɪ weɪt bɪˈfɔr ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那要先放一下再用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, five minutes so it turns thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs faɪv ˈmɪnɪts soʊ ɪt tɜrnz θɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it... but we have no lemons at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt bʌt wi hæv noʊ ˈlɛmənz æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 記下了……可是一顆檸檬都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use white vinegar instead, same amount.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz waɪt ˈvɪnəˌgɛr ɪnˈstɛd seɪm əˈmaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 那就改用白醋，分量一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, we've got that. Anything else, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wiv ɡɑt ðæt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那個有。還有別的要注意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the heat medium; low makes them tough.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə hit ˈmidi loʊ meɪks ðɛm tɔf/
dialogue.zh: 火開中等，太小會讓餅變硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody told me that. Lumpy batter or smooth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbʌdi ˈtoʊld mi ðæt ˈlʌmpi ˈbætər ɔr smuð/
dialogue.zh: 沒人跟我說過。麵糊要有顆粒還是攪滑？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lumpy is fine. Don't overmix it, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌmpi ɪz faɪn doʊnt ˌoʊvərˈmɪks ɪt səˈrɪəzli/
dialogue.zh: 有顆粒沒關係，真的別攪太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, dinner is saved thanks to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈdɪnər ɪz seɪvd θæŋks tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，今晚這頓靠你救回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy those pancakes! Call back if stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðoʊz ˈpænˌkeɪks kɔl bæk ɪf stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢享用鬆餅！卡住再打來。
